description: This file handles the repair process for inbound email accounts in a SuiteCRM module. It queries active inbound email records, attempts to repair each account via a Bean method, and displays success or failure messages accordingly.

classes.name: InboundEmail
classes.description: Represents an inbound email account with methods to retrieve and repair it.

methods.name: repairIE
methods.description: Main logic for repairing inbound email accounts, querying active accounts, attempting repairs, and displaying results.
